title: Venmar — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Venmar.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Forever Clean Air." Specialty tier. Venmar is the Canadian heat recovery ventilation (HRV) and energy recovery ventilation (ERV) brand from Broan-NuTone. Essential for Canadian homes where tight building envelopes require mechanical ventilation. Venmar is the standard in Canadian new construction.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Canadian new home construction. HRV/ERV installations. Energy-efficient home ventilation.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Venmar:

• Canadian standard for HRV/ERV ventilation

• Essential for modern tight-envelope homes

• Broan-NuTone engineering and support

• Widest selection of HRV/ERV units in Canada

• Required by code in many Canadian jurisdictions
